card.name: Linking words in drug-label sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation such as of, or, /, when and receiving, placed between a drug, patient group or condition and the next term. Seen in drug-label prose on adverse events, indications and contraindications.

modes.label: Of after percentage or treatment
modes.description: The word of follows a percentage, a treatment or an administration phrase.
modes.example: There were 0 cases of myocardial infarction in nintedanib capsules-treated patients compared to 0.7%<< of>> placebo-treated patients.

modes.label: Joiner between drug names
modes.description: An or or slash links two drug names in a pair or combination.

modes.label: Sentence opener after a risk list
modes.description: The word When begins a sentence right after a list of adverse effects.
modes.example: Potential neonatal adverse effects include skull hypoplasia, anuria, hypotension, renal failure, and death.<< When>> pregnancy is detected, discontinue losart
